Title: Request reset link with valid registered email
Precondition: User has an account with an email on file
Steps: 1. Go to login page 2. Click 'Forgot password?' 3. Enter registered email 4. Submit
Expected Result: System sends a reset email and shows a confirmation message

Title: Request reset link with unregistered email
Precondition: No account exists for the entered email
Steps: 1. Go to login page 2. Click 'Forgot password?' 3. Enter an email not on file 4. Submit
Expected Result: System shows a generic confirmation message without revealing whether the email exists

Title: Reset link takes user directly to new password screen
Precondition: User requested a reset link within the last 30 minutes
Steps: 1. Open the reset email 2. Click the reset link
Expected Result: User is taken directly to the Set New Password screen

Title: Expired reset link is rejected
Precondition: Reset link was requested more than 30 minutes ago
Steps: 1. Wait 31+ minutes after requesting reset 2. Click the reset link
Expected Result: System shows 'This link has expired' and prompts the user to request a new one

Title: Set new password with valid strength
Precondition: User has clicked a valid reset link
Steps: 1. Enter a new password meeting strength rules 2. Confirm password 3. Submit
Expected Result: Password is updated and user is redirected to login with a success message

Title: Reject weak new password
Precondition: User has clicked a valid reset link
Steps: 1. Enter a password under 8 characters 2. Submit
Expected Result: System shows a validation error and does not update the password

Title: Reused reset link is rejected after use
Precondition: Reset link has already been used once to set a password
Steps: 1. Click the same reset link a second time
Expected Result: System shows 'This link is no longer valid'

Title: Rate limit repeated reset requests
Precondition: User has requested a reset link 3 times in the last 10 minutes
Steps: 1. Request a reset link a 4th time within 10 minutes
Expected Result: System throttles the request and shows a 'please wait before trying again' message
